headline: Earnings and margins climb on a tariff-refund tailwind
summary_short: Apple reported diluted EPS of $2.02 (+28.7% y/y) on revenue of $109.42B (+16.4% y/y) and net income of $29.79B (+27.1% y/y), with gross margin at 50.1% including a tariff-refund tailwind.
summary_long: Revenue was $109.42B (+16.4% y/y, -1.6% q/q); gross margin rose to 50.1%, aided by roughly 2 points of favorable tariff-refund impact the release discloses explicitly. Diluted EPS of $2.02 (+28.7% y/y) included $0.11 from the same refunds. Net income reached $29.79B (+27.1% y/y). Cash fell to $39.54B (-13.2% q/q, +9.0% y/y) after nine-month buybacks of $62.09B and dividends of $11.78B, while shareholders' equity rose 63.3% y/y to $107.52B. The board declared a $0.27/share dividend, payable August 13, 2026. The release contains no forward guidance.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited the strongest June quarter ever, with double-digit revenue growth across iPhone, Mac and Services and every geographic segment; CFO cited record EPS and operating cash flow.
Company states gross margin included approximately 2 percentage points of favorable impact from tariff refunds this quarter.
Company states diluted EPS growth included a $0.11 favorable impact from tariff refunds.
